========================================
GNU extended asm with fused :: sections
========================================

void f(void) {
  __asm__ volatile("b code" ::: "memory");
  int out, in = 1;
  __asm__("mov %0, %1" : "=r"(out) : "r"(in) : "r0");
}

---

(translation_unit
    (function_definition
        (primitive_type)
        (function_declarator
            (identifier)
            (parameter_list
                (parameter_declaration
                    (primitive_type))))
        (compound_statement
            (expression_statement
                (gnu_asm_expression
                    (gnu_asm_qualifier)
                    (string_literal
                        (string_content))
                    (string_literal
                        (string_content))))
            (declaration
                (primitive_type)
                (identifier)
                (init_declarator
                    (identifier)
                    (number_literal)))
            (expression_statement
                (gnu_asm_expression
                    (string_literal
                        (string_content))
                    (gnu_asm_output_operand_list
                        (gnu_asm_output_operand
                            (string_literal
                                (string_content))
                            (identifier)))
                    (gnu_asm_input_operand_list
                        (gnu_asm_input_operand
                            (string_literal
                                (string_content))
                            (identifier)))
                    (gnu_asm_clobber_list
                        (string_literal
                            (string_content))))))))
